senses.gloss: sīma, nt.; also sīman, m. or f., or sīmā, f., a moderately high number: sīmaṃ Mvy 〔7836〕, cited from Gv 〔133.2〕; in Gv 〔105.20〕 gen. sattvāsīnasya, read sattva-sīmasya; sīmā, n. sg., Mvy 〔7710〕.
sīmātikrāntika, adj. (Pali ˚kkantika), with kaṭhinoddhāra, due to (a monkʼs) having crossed the boundary (of the vihāra): MSV 〔ii.161.18〕; 〔163.4〕.

sīmāvati, presumably for ˚vatī, = Skt. sīmā, boundary (cf. 〔§ 22.50〕): sarvabuddhadarśana-˚ti-krameṇa bodhisattva-samādhinā Gv 〔39.5〕 (prose), march to the limit of all-Buddha-views (? insight); in a list of bodhisattvasamādhis.
